notes.title: Devlog #1 – Echoes from the Depths
notes.notes:
[p]Since launching our Steam page, we've been a bit silent, but for a good reason![/p][p][/p][p]We've been hard at work on the development of The Shadow Beneath, preparing our very first playtest. A big thank you to everyone who shared feedback - we made several improvements to our Steam page and we even revamped our logo(which became a Reddit meme)[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45645234/b6dca50ff8dcdf8ab465cde1d2dcb857fbe53e14.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]As for the game itself, we are deep into content creation and polishing. That means everything from menus to combat, skill effects and overall balance is getting refined in order to create an epic experience.[/p][p][/p][p]That being said, this is just the first of many devlogs and we are excited to share more with you as development continues. Your feedback was already proven valuable and we want you to be a key part of this journey.[/p][p][/p][p]So stay tuned and don't forget to follow us here, on Steam, but also on our Youtube page for more updates and content : 👉 [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@techadise"][/dynamiclink]


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3389620/The_Shadow_Beneath/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
